headline: Whirlbite Prismana
title: Whirlbite Prismana | Dark Water Form | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Whirlbite has a Prismana Form that adds the Dark element to Water. Its base attack is one hundred twenty two, so it hits hard in either form. Bone-Splitting Bite is a Dark skill that costs twenty energy and punishes a target for every attack or skill it uses. The Aniilog also pays research points for collecting a Prismana Form. Would you pick Dark Water Whirlbite? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Whirlbite Prismana Form guide: the form adds Dark to Water and Whirlbite learns the Dark skill Bone-Splitting Bite. Collecting it also earns Aniilog research points. Checked on aniimo.gg and GameWith in November 2026.
joke: The Prismana glow makes Whirlbite look like a ghost that learned to swim.
